Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: World Bank reports DRC’s Automated Transfer System (ATS) providing RTGS+ACH was deployed Sep 2017 and is managed by the Banque Centrale du Congo (BCC), enabling same-day electronic retail settlement, while the national payments card retail switch became operational Dec 2020 but with limited operations (11 banks connected, 5 operating, 6 testing) so deployment is partial rather than fully nationwide.
